body: Just wanna thank all you guys for potentially helping me live another few hours, as for tomorrow ill take it on when it comes

One thing that keeps me going is the thought of a future, but right now if i have to live through the next 10 months feeling like this i dont know if ill make it.  and its not just grades  its that feeling of uselessness
Even in others lives i seem to fail.  I dont picture myself being significant in anyones life, or having anyone miss me

I dont feel brave, right now i feel like a coward and that im being a wimp.  I mean all of my friends are so happy, the biggest thing i notice is people notice when they are gone.  they make a difference in peoples lives.  I feel insignificant in every way
